acv-mcp.description: Stdio MCP server owning all sandbox/test-runner tools. Runs as a host Node process launched via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} (which Claude Code expands at config-parse time, unlike ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}). The server resolves its provenance dir from CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR at runtime and writes nothing unless the project is activated (acv.config.json present). Build once with `npm -w mcp-server run build`. The docker sandbox provider still shells out to `docker run` to isolate target code; the MCP host itself no longer needs a container.
